newsitem.title: USA: Lucent, BellSouth in number portability deal.
newsitem.headline: Lucent, BellSouth in number portability deal.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said Tuesday it would supply BellSouth Corp with the technology needed to allow customers to keep their phone numbers even if they switched to rival local carriers.
Lucent and BellSouth, who signed the deal on Monday, said it was worth a "significant" amount, without elaborating.
BellSouth said it needed the technology to comply with requirements set under the Telecommunications Act of 1996.
Lucent, which signed a similar deal with Ameritech Corp in January, said it would begin installing the equipment for the phone company's nine-state region in the second quarter.
